entities.name: First Soviet Occupation & Nazi Occupation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Soviet occupation (June 1940), the June 1941 deportation of over 17,000 Lithuanians, the brief June Uprising (1941), Nazi occupation and the Holocaust (over 190,000 Lithuanian Jews murdered — 95% of the community), the Riga and Kaunas ghettos, and the complicity of Lithuanian collaborators.
